import gleam/list
import gleam/string
import gleam/dict.{type Dict}
pub type MorphemeType {
  Root
  Prefix
  Suffix
  Infix
}
pub type Morpheme {
  Morpheme(text: String, morph_type: MorphemeType, pos_tag: String)
}
pub fn analyze(text: String) -> List(Morpheme) {
  let words = string.split(text, " ")
  list.flat_map(words, segment_word)
}
fn segment_word(word: String) -> List(Morpheme) {
  let prefixes = ["un", "re", "pre", "dis", "mis"]
  let suffixes = ["ing", "ed", "er", "est", "ly", "ness"]
  let found_prefix = list.find(prefixes, fn(p) { string.starts_with(word, p) })
  let found_suffix = list.find(suffixes, fn(s) { string.ends_with(word, s) })
  case found_prefix, found_suffix {
    Ok(prefix), Ok(suffix) -> {
      let root_start = string.length(prefix)
      let root_end = string.length(word) - string.length(suffix)
      let root = string.slice(word, root_start, root_end - root_start)
      [
        Morpheme(prefix, Prefix, "PREFIX"),
        Morpheme(root, Root, "ROOT"),
        Morpheme(suffix, Suffix, "SUFFIX"),
      ]
    }
    Ok(prefix), Error(_) -> {
      let root = string.drop_left(word, string.length(prefix))
      [
        Morpheme(prefix, Prefix, "PREFIX"),
        Morpheme(root, Root, "ROOT"),
      ]
    }
    Error(_), Ok(suffix) -> {
      let root = string.drop_right(word, string.length(suffix))
      [
        Morpheme(root, Root, "ROOT"),
        Morpheme(suffix, Suffix, "SUFFIX"),
      ]
    }
    Error(_), Error(_) -> [
      Morpheme(word, Root, "ROOT"),
    ]
  }
}
pub fn phonetic_similarity(word1: String, word2: String) -> Float {
  let soundex1 = soundex(word1)
  let soundex2 = soundex(word2)
  case soundex1 == soundex2 {
    True -> 1.0
    False -> levenshtein_similarity(word1, word2)
  }
}
fn soundex(word: String) -> String {
  case string.to_graphemes(word) {
    [] -> ""
    [first, ..rest] -> {
      let code = string.uppercase(first)
      let digits = list.filter_map(rest, char_to_soundex_digit)
        |> list.take(3)
        |> string.join("")
      code <> string.pad_right(digits, 3, "0")
    }
  }
}
fn char_to_soundex_digit(char: String) -> Result(String, Nil) {
  case string.lowercase(char) {
    "b" | "f" | "p" | "v" -> Ok("1")
    "c" | "g" | "j" | "k" | "q" | "s" | "x" | "z" -> Ok("2")
    "d" | "t" -> Ok("3")
    "l" -> Ok("4")
    "m" | "n" -> Ok("5")
    "r" -> Ok("6")
    _ -> Error(Nil)
  }
}
fn levenshtein_similarity(s1: String, s2: String) -> Float {
  let len1 = string.length(s1)
  let len2 = string.length(s2)
  let max_len = case len1 > len2 {
    True -> len1
    False -> len2
  }
  let distance = levenshtein_distance(s1, s2)
  1.0 -. int.to_float(distance) /. int.to_float(max_len)
}
fn levenshtein_distance(s1: String, s2: String) -> Int {
  let chars1 = string.to_graphemes(s1)
  let chars2 = string.to_graphemes(s2)
  case chars1, chars2 {
    [], _ -> list.length(chars2)
    _, [] -> list.length(chars1)
    [c1, ..rest1], [c2, ..rest2] -> {
      case c1 == c2 {
        True -> levenshtein_distance(string.join(rest1, ""), string.join(rest2, ""))
        False -> {
          let delete_cost = 1 + levenshtein_distance(string.join(rest1, ""), s2)
          let insert_cost = 1 + levenshtein_distance(s1, string.join(rest2, ""))
          let replace_cost = 1 + levenshtein_distance(string.join(rest1, ""), string.join(rest2, ""))
          int.min(delete_cost, int.min(insert_cost, replace_cost))
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

import gleam/list
import gleam/float
pub type FisherMatrix {
  FisherMatrix(elements: List(List(Float)))
}
pub fn compute_fisher_information(
  model_output: List(Float),
  targets: List(Float),
) -> FisherMatrix {
  let n = list.length(model_output)
  let fisher = list.map(list.range(0, n - 1), fn(i) {
    list.map(list.range(0, n - 1), fn(j) {
      let pi = result.unwrap(list.at(model_output, i), 0.0)
      let pj = result.unwrap(list.at(model_output, j), 0.0)
      case i == j {
        True -> pi *. {1.0 -. pi}
        False -> -1.0 *. pi *. pj
      }
    })
  })
  FisherMatrix(fisher)
}
pub fn natural_gradient_step(
  gradient: List(Float),
  fisher: FisherMatrix,
  learning_rate: Float,
) -> List(Float) {
  let fisher_inv = invert_matrix(fisher.elements)
  let natural_grad = matrix_vector_multiply(fisher_inv, gradient)
  list.map(natural_grad, fn(g) { g *. learning_rate })
}
fn invert_matrix(matrix: List(List(Float))) -> List(List(Float)) {
  let n = list.length(matrix)
  let identity = list.map(list.range(0, n - 1), fn(i) {
    list.map(list.range(0, n - 1), fn(j) {
      case i == j {
        True -> 1.0
        False -> 0.0
      }
    })
  })
  gauss_jordan(matrix, identity)
}
fn gauss_jordan(a: List(List(Float)), b: List(List(Float))) -> List(List(Float)) {
  b
}
fn matrix_vector_multiply(matrix: List(List(Float)), vector: List(Float)) -> List(Float) {
  list.map(matrix, fn(row) {
    list.zip(row, vector)
    |> list.map(fn(pair) { pair.0 *. pair.1 })
    |> list.fold(0.0, float.add)
  })
}

import gleam/list
import gleam/dict.{type Dict}
import gleam/string
import gleam/int
pub type DHTNode {
  DHTNode(
    node_id: String,
    address: String,
    port: Int,
    stored_keys: Dict(String, String),
  )
}
pub type DHTNetwork {
  DHTNetwork(nodes: List(DHTNode), key_space_bits: Int)
}
pub fn create_network(num_nodes: Int, key_bits: Int) -> DHTNetwork {
  let nodes = list.map(list.range(0, num_nodes - 1), fn(i) {
    DHTNode(
      node_id: hash_to_id(int.to_string(i), key_bits),
      address: "0.0.0.0",
      port: 5000 + i,
      stored_keys: dict.new(),
    )
  })
  DHTNetwork(nodes: nodes, key_space_bits: key_bits)
}
fn hash_to_id(value: String, bits: Int) -> String {
  let hash_val = simple_hash(value)
  let max_val = int.bitwise_shift_left(1, bits)
  let id = int.remainder(hash_val, max_val) |> result.unwrap(0)
  int.to_string(id)
}
fn simple_hash(s: String) -> Int {
  string.to_utf_codepoints(s)
  |> list.fold(5381, fn(hash, char) {
    int.bitwise_shift_left(hash, 5) + hash + char
  })
}
pub fn store(network: DHTNetwork, key: String, value: String) -> DHTNetwork {
  let key_id = hash_to_id(key, network.key_space_bits)
  let target_node = find_closest_node(network, key_id)
  let updated_nodes = list.map(network.nodes, fn(node) {
    case node.node_id == target_node.node_id {
      True -> DHTNode(
        ..node,
        stored_keys: dict.insert(node.stored_keys, key, value),
      )
      False -> node
    }
  })
  DHTNetwork(..network, nodes: updated_nodes)
}
pub fn retrieve(network: DHTNetwork, key: String) -> Result(String, Nil) {
  let key_id = hash_to_id(key, network.key_space_bits)
  let target_node = find_closest_node(network, key_id)
  dict.get(target_node.stored_keys, key)
}
fn find_closest_node(network: DHTNetwork, target_id: String) -> DHTNode {
  let target_val = int.parse(target_id) |> result.unwrap(0)
  list.fold(network.nodes, list.first(network.nodes) |> result.unwrap(DHTNode("0", "", 0, dict.new())), fn(closest, node) {
    let node_val = int.parse(node.node_id) |> result.unwrap(0)
    let closest_val = int.parse(closest.node_id) |> result.unwrap(0)
    let node_dist = int.absolute_value(node_val - target_val)
    let closest_dist = int.absolute_value(closest_val - target_val)
    case node_dist < closest_dist {
      True -> node
      False -> closest
    }
  })
}

import Lean.Meta
import Lean.Elab

namespace KANVerification

structure Gradient where
  values : List Float
  norm_bound : Float
  lipschitz_constant : Float
  deriving Repr

def is_bounded (g : Gradient) (bound : Float) : Prop :=
  ∀ v ∈ g.values, |v| ≤ bound

def satisfies_lipschitz (g₁ g₂ : Gradient) (L : Float) : Prop :=
  let diff := List.zipWith (· - ·) g₁.values g₂.values
  let norm := Float.sqrt (diff.foldl (fun acc x => acc + x * x) 0.0)
  norm ≤ L * g₁.lipschitz_constant

theorem gradient_composition_preserves_bounds
  (g₁ g₂ : Gradient)
  (h₁ : is_bounded g₁ g₁.norm_bound)
  (h₂ : is_bounded g₂ g₂.norm_bound) :
  is_bounded 
    { values := List.zipWith (· * ·) g₁.values g₂.values,
      norm_bound := g₁.norm_bound * g₂.norm_bound,
      lipschitz_constant := g₁.lipschitz_constant * g₂.lipschitz_constant }
    (g₁.norm_bound * g₂.norm_bound) := by
  intro v hv
  simp [is_bounded] at h₁ h₂ ⊢
  obtain ⟨v₁, hv₁, v₂, hv₂, rfl⟩ := hv
  calc |v₁ * v₂|
      = |v₁| * |v₂| := abs_mul v₁ v₂
    _ ≤ g₁.norm_bound * |v₂| := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (h₁ v₁ hv₁) (abs_nonneg v₂)
    _ ≤ g₁.norm_bound * g₂.norm_bound := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h₂ v₂ hv₂) (by linarith)

def refine_gradient_type (g : Gradient) : { g' : Gradient // is_bounded g' g.norm_bound } :=
  ⟨g, by
    intro v hv
    exact Float.le_refl g.norm_bound⟩

structure KANLayer where
  weights : List (List Float)
  spline_coeffs : List (List Float)
  grid_size : Nat
  deriving Repr

def forward_pass (layer : KANLayer) (input : List Float) : List Float :=
  layer.weights.map fun w_row =>
    List.zipWith (· * ·) w_row input
    |> List.foldl (· + ·) 0.0

def backward_pass (layer : KANLayer) (grad_output : List Float) : Gradient :=
  let grad_input := layer.weights.map fun w_row =>
    List.zipWith (· * ·) w_row grad_output
    |> List.foldl (· + ·) 0.0
  
  { values := grad_input,
    norm_bound := 1.0,
    lipschitz_constant := 1.0 }

theorem backprop_gradient_bound
  (layer : KANLayer)
  (grad_out : List Float)
  (bound : Float)
  (h : ∀ g ∈ grad_out, |g| ≤ bound) :
  is_bounded (backward_pass layer grad_out) bound := by
  intro v hv
  simp [backward_pass] at hv
  sorry

  let current_norm := Float.sqrt (g.values.foldl (fun acc x => acc + x * x) 0.0)

    let scale := max_norm / current_norm
    { values := g.values.map (· * scale),
      norm_bound := max_norm,
      lipschitz_constant := g.lipschitz_constant * scale }
  else

pub type MorphemeType {
  Root

  Infix

pub type Morpheme {
  Morpheme(text: String, morph_type: MorphemeType, pos_tag: String)

pub fn analyze(text: String) -> List(Morpheme) {
  let words = string.split(text, " ")

fn segment_word(word: String) -> List(Morpheme) {
  let prefixes = ["un", "re", "pre", "dis", "mis"]
  let suffixes = ["ing", "ed", "er", "est", "ly", "ness"]
  let found_prefix = list.find(prefixes, fn(p) { string.starts_with(word, p) })
  let found_suffix = list.find(suffixes, fn(s) { string.ends_with(word, s) })
  case found_prefix, found_suffix {
    Ok(prefix), Ok(suffix) -> {
      let root_start = string.length(prefix)
      let root_end = string.length(word) - string.length(suffix)
      let root = string.slice(word, root_start, root_end - root_start)
      [
        Morpheme(prefix, Prefix, "PREFIX"),
        Morpheme(root, Root, "ROOT"),
        Morpheme(suffix, Suffix, "SUFFIX"),
      ]
    }
    Ok(prefix), Error(_) -> {
      let root = string.drop_left(word, string.length(prefix))
      [
        Morpheme(prefix, Prefix, "PREFIX"),
        Morpheme(root, Root, "ROOT"),
      ]
    }
    Error(_), Ok(suffix) -> {
      let root = string.drop_right(word, string.length(suffix))
      [
        Morpheme(root, Root, "ROOT"),
        Morpheme(suffix, Suffix, "SUFFIX"),
      ]
    }
    Error(_), Error(_) -> [
      Morpheme(word, Root, "ROOT"),
    ]
  }

  let soundex1 = soundex(word1)
  let soundex2 = soundex(word2)
  case soundex1 == soundex2 {
    True -> 1.0
    False -> levenshtein_similarity(word1, word2)
  }
}
fn soundex(word: String) -> String {
  case string.to_graphemes(word) {
    [] -> ""
    [first, ..rest] -> {
      let code = string.uppercase(first)
      let digits = list.filter_map(rest, char_to_soundex_digit)
        |> list.take(3)
        |> string.join("")
      code <> string.pad_right(digits, 3, "0")
    }
  }
}
fn char_to_soundex_digit(char: String) -> Result(String, Nil) {
  case string.lowercase(char) {
    "b" | "f" | "p" | "v" -> Ok("1")
    "c" | "g" | "j" | "k" | "q" | "s" | "x" | "z" -> Ok("2")
    "d" | "t" -> Ok("3")
    "l" -> Ok("4")
    "m" | "n" -> Ok("5")
    "r" -> Ok("6")
    _ -> Error(Nil)
  }
}
fn levenshtein_similarity(s1: String, s2: String) -> Float {
  let len1 = string.length(s1)
  let len2 = string.length(s2)
  let max_len = case len1 > len2 {
    True -> len1
    False -> len2
  }
  let distance = levenshtein_distance(s1, s2)
  1.0 -. int.to_float(distance) /. int.to_float(max_len)
}
fn levenshtein_distance(s1: String, s2: String) -> Int {
  let chars1 = string.to_graphemes(s1)
  let chars2 = string.to_graphemes(s2)
  case chars1, chars2 {
    [], _ -> list.length(chars2)
    _, [] -> list.length(chars1)
    [c1, ..rest1], [c2, ..rest2] -> {
      case c1 == c2 {
        True -> levenshtein_distance(string.join(rest1, ""), string.join(rest2, ""))
        False -> {
          let delete_cost = 1 + levenshtein_distance(string.join(rest1, ""), s2)
          let insert_cost = 1 + levenshtein_distance(s1, string.join(rest2, ""))
          let replace_cost = 1 + levenshtein_distance(string.join(rest1, ""), string.join(rest2, ""))
          int.min(delete_cost, int.min(insert_cost, replace_cost))
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

pub type DHTNetwork {
  DHTNetwork(nodes: List(DHTNode), key_space_bits: Int)

pub fn create_network(num_nodes: Int, key_bits: Int) -> DHTNetwork {
  let nodes = list.map(list.range(0, num_nodes - 1), fn(i) {
    DHTNode(
      node_id: hash_to_id(int.to_string(i), key_bits),
      address: "0.0.0.0",

      stored_keys: dict.new(),
    )
  })
  DHTNetwork(nodes: nodes, key_space_bits: key_bits)
}
fn hash_to_id(value: String, bits: Int) -> String {
  let hash_val = simple_hash(value)
  let max_val = int.bitwise_shift_left(1, bits)
  let id = int.remainder(hash_val, max_val) |> result.unwrap(0)
  int.to_string(id)
}
fn simple_hash(s: String) -> Int {
  string.to_utf_codepoints(s)
  |> list.fold(5381, fn(hash, char) {
    int.bitwise_shift_left(hash, 5) + hash + char
  })
}
pub fn store(network: DHTNetwork, key: String, value: String) -> DHTNetwork {
  let key_id = hash_to_id(key, network.key_space_bits)
  let target_node = find_closest_node(network, key_id)
  let updated_nodes = list.map(network.nodes, fn(node) {
    case node.node_id == target_node.node_id {
      True -> DHTNode(
        ..node,
        stored_keys: dict.insert(node.stored_keys, key, value),
      )
      False -> node
    }
  })
  DHTNetwork(..network, nodes: updated_nodes)
}
pub fn retrieve(network: DHTNetwork, key: String) -> Result(String, Nil) {
  let key_id = hash_to_id(key, network.key_space_bits)
  let target_node = find_closest_node(network, key_id)
  dict.get(target_node.stored_keys, key)
}
fn find_closest_node(network: DHTNetwork, target_id: String) -> DHTNode {
  let target_val = int.parse(target_id) |> result.unwrap(0)
  list.fold(network.nodes, list.first(network.nodes) |> result.unwrap(DHTNode("0", "", 0, dict.new())), fn(closest, node) {
    let node_val = int.parse(node.node_id) |> result.unwrap(0)
    let closest_val = int.parse(closest.node_id) |> result.unwrap(0)
    let node_dist = int.absolute_value(node_val - target_val)
    let closest_dist = int.absolute_value(closest_val - target_val)
    case node_dist < closest_dist {
      True -> node
      False -> closest
    }
  })

structure Gradient where
  values : List Float
  norm_bound : Float
  lipschitz_constant : Float
  deriving Repr

def is_bounded (g : Gradient) (bound : Float) : Prop :=
  ∀ v ∈ g.values, |v| ≤ bound

def satisfies_lipschitz (g₁ g₂ : Gradient) (L : Float) : Prop :=
  let diff := List.zipWith (· - ·) g₁.values g₂.values
  let norm := Float.sqrt (diff.foldl (fun acc x => acc + x * x) 0.0)
  norm ≤ L * g₁.lipschitz_constant

theorem gradient_composition_preserves_bounds
  (g₁ g₂ : Gradient)
  (h₁ : is_bounded g₁ g₁.norm_bound)
  (h₂ : is_bounded g₂ g₂.norm_bound) :
  is_bounded 
    { values := List.zipWith (· * ·) g₁.values g₂.values,
      norm_bound := g₁.norm_bound * g₂.norm_bound,
      lipschitz_constant := g₁.lipschitz_constant * g₂.lipschitz_constant }
    (g₁.norm_bound * g₂.norm_bound) := by
  intro v hv
  simp [is_bounded] at h₁ h₂ ⊢
  obtain ⟨v₁, hv₁, v₂, hv₂, rfl⟩ := hv
  calc |v₁ * v₂|
      = |v₁| * |v₂| := abs_mul v₁ v₂
    _ ≤ g₁.norm_bound * |v₂| := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (h₁ v₁ hv₁) (abs_nonneg v₂)
    _ ≤ g₁.norm_bound * g₂.norm_bound := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h₂ v₂ hv₂) (by linarith)

def backward_pass (layer : KANLayer) (grad_output : List Float) : Gradient :=
  let grad_input := layer.weights.map fun w_row =>
    List.zipWith (· * ·) w_row grad_output
    |> List.foldl (· + ·) 0.0

pub fn compute_input_complexity(input: Matrix) -> Float {
  let variance = matrix.variance(input)
  let entropy = matrix.entropy(input)
  let spectral_norm = matrix.spectral_norm(input)
  
  let complexity_score = variance *. 0.3 +. entropy *. 0.4 +. spectral_norm *. 0.3
  complexity_score
}

pub fn adapt_grid_size(layer: AdaptiveKANLayer, complexity: Float) -> AdaptiveKANLayer {
  let new_grid = case complexity {
    c if c <. 0.3 -> layer.base_grid
    c if c <. 0.6 -> layer.base_grid * 2
    c if c <. 0.8 -> layer.base_grid * 3
    _ -> layer.base_grid * 4
  }
  
  AdaptiveKANLayer(..layer, current_grid: new_grid)
}

  layer: AdaptiveKANLayer,
  input: Matrix,
  level: Int,
) -> Matrix {
  case level >= layer.hierarchical_levels {

    False -> {
      let control_pts = result.unwrap(list.at(layer.control_points, level), matrix.zeros(1, 1))
      let spline_output = evaluate_bspline(input, control_pts, layer.spline_degree)
      let next_input = matrix.add(input, spline_output)
      hierarchical_forward(layer, next_input, level + 1)
    }
  }
}

fn evaluate_bspline(input: Matrix, control_points: Matrix, degree: Int) -> Matrix {

  matrix.map2(input, fn(x, _i, _j) {
    let basis_values = compute_basis_functions(x, knots, degree)

fn generate_uniform_knots(num_control_points: Int, degree: Int) -> List(Float) {
  let num_knots = num_control_points + degree + 1
  list.map(list.range(0, num_knots - 1), fn(i) {
    int.to_float(i) /. int.to_float(num_knots - 1)
  })

    let next_knot = result.unwrap(list.at(knots, i + 1), knot +. 1.0)
    case x >=. knot && x <. next_knot {
      True -> 1.0
      False -> 0.0
    }
  })
}

fn compute_basis_recursive(x: Float, knots: List(Float), degree: Int) -> List(Float) {
  let lower_basis = compute_basis_functions(x, knots, degree - 1)
  list.index_map(lower_basis, fn(basis_val, i) {
    let knot_i = result.unwrap(list.at(knots, i), 0.0)
    let knot_i_deg = result.unwrap(list.at(knots, i + degree), 1.0)
    let knot_i_1 = result.unwrap(list.at(knots, i + 1), 0.0)
    let knot_i_deg_1 = result.unwrap(list.at(knots, i + degree + 1), 1.0)

    let term2 = case denom2 >. 0.0 {
      True -> {knot_i_deg_1 -. x} /. denom2 *. next_basis
      False -> 0.0
    }
    
    term1 +. term2
  })
}
